description: Move Lead to Another List - Move a lead from one list to another. If the destination list is used by an active sequence that takes new contacts, the lead is scheduled into it automatically. Recipients are the contacts the account holder supplies. Blocklist and unsubscribes are always enforced.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.
